literal_meaning: ধোঁয়া এবং ঢাকের শব্দ (smoke and drum beats, evoking noisy celebrations)
figurative_meaning_en: Great pomp and show; grand ceremony with much fanfare
example_sentences_in_bangla: ধূমধাম করে তার বাড়ির উদ্বোধন হল।
example_sentences_in_english: The inauguration of his house was done with great pomp.
The wedding was celebrated with much fanfare.
note: Variants like ধূমধড়াক্কা emphasize noisy spectacle in traditional Bengali festivities.
